counting: SP-GIT-01 qualifies existing SP-ACL-REVIEW-01; do not count it as another disclosure. SP-GIT-02 is a separate shared-service configuration finding, pending reconciliation with the estate register.

records.title: Pod Git applies the pod component twice and authorises only the root
records.disposition: The adapter passes data_root/pod as the service root and retains /pod in the request path. Normal repositories are missed; a nested repository can be selected under root-only Read. The native normal/nested repository probe is still running. Correcting the root alone would expose normal history to the same insufficient authority decision.
records.acceptance: Repair selection and whole-history export authority together. Exercise normal and nested repositories, private children, historic versions, permitted and denied callers, Git discovery and object delivery. Verify the feature and policy in actual consumers.

records.title: Git CGI permits known hidden-tip requests despite mirror ref hiding
records.disposition: The shared service forces uploadpack.allowTipSHA1InWant=true. A fresh synthetic local Git fixture confirms hidden-tip pack delivery, with denied delivery when false and discovery hiding in both cases. Forge uses this service; the Rust HTTP regression is queued. No live forge or mirror relay was exercised.
records.acceptance: Deny direct hidden-object requests despite permissive repository-local settings while keeping advertised-tip fetches working. Test the shared HTTP service and forge adapter. Establish a separate object-publication boundary for held mirror objects, including fetch and validation races; ref hiding and a single configuration switch do not establish complete repository read isolation. Verify consumer adoption separately.
